mapper.select: select count(1) from msds_main where is_active = 1 and (expiry_date is null or expiry_date > now())
select count(1) from msds_main where is_active = 0
select count(1) from msds_main where expiry_date is not null and expiry_date < now()
select count(1) from msds_document_access_log where date(access_time) = curdate() and access_type = 'view'
select count(1) from msds_document_access_log where year(access_time) = year(now()) and month(access_time) = month(now()) and access_type = 'view'
select count(1) from msds_document_access_log where access_type = 'view'
select count(distinct user_id) from msds_document_access_log where access_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 7 day)
select count(1) from msds_document_access_log where date(access_time) = curdate() and access_type = 'download'
select count(1) from msds_document_access_log where year(access_time) = year(now()) and month(access_time) = month(now()) and access_type = 'download'
select count(1) from msds_document_access_log where access_type = 'download'

select count(distinct m.id) from msds_main m left join msds_hazard h on m.id = h.msds_id where m.is_active = 1 and (h.warning_word = 'danger' or h.hazard_category like '%毒害%' or h.hazard_category like '%易燃%' or h.hazard_category like '%腐蚀%')
select count(distinct cas_number) from msds_main where cas_number is not null and cas_number != ''
select count(distinct company_name) from msds_main where company_name is not null and company_name != ''

select date(oper_time) as date,
count(1) as visits, 0 as uniqueVisitors, 0 as pageViews
0 as visits, count(distinct oper_name) as uniqueVisitors, 0 as pageViews
0 as visits, 0 as uniqueVisitors, count(1) as pageViews
count(1) as visits, count(distinct oper_name) as uniqueVisitors, count(1) as pageViews
from sys_oper_log where date(oper_time) between #{startDate} and #{endDate} group by date(oper_time) order by date(oper_time)

select date(oper_time) as date, hour(oper_time) as hour, count(1) as count, '访问' as type from sys_oper_log where oper_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 7 day) group by date(oper_time), hour(oper_time)
union all
select date(oper_time) as date, hour(oper_time) as hour, count(1) as count, '下载' as type from sys_oper_log where oper_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 7 day) and oper_name like '%下载%' group by date(oper_time), hour(oper_time)
order by date, hour

select date(oper_time) as date, count(1) as downloads, 'PDF' as fileType, oper_id as documentId, oper_name as documentName from sys_oper_log where oper_time >=
date_sub(now(), interval 7 day) date_sub(now(), interval 30 day) date_sub(now(), interval 90 day)
and oper_name like '%下载%' group by date(oper_time), oper_id, oper_name order by date(oper_time) desc, downloads desc

select m.msds_id as id, m.product_name as name, '化学品' as category, coalesce(av.views, 0) as views, coalesce(dv.downloads, 0) as downloads, date_format(m.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as updateTime, '中危' as dangerLevel, m.cas_number as casNumber from msds_main m left join ( select oper_id, count(1) as views from sys_oper_log where oper_name like '%查询%' or oper_name like '%访问%' group by oper_id ) av on m.msds_id = av.oper_id left join ( select oper_id, count(1) as downloads from sys_oper_log where oper_name like '%下载%' group by oper_id ) dv on m.msds_id = dv.oper_id where m.is_active = 1 order by
coalesce(dv.downloads, 0) desc coalesce(av.views, 0) desc
limit 10
